description:
1. Agent reads `.claude/project-context.md`, extracts Section 6 (primary keywords: 'non-toxic cleaning products', 'eco-friendly household cleaners', etc.) and Section 11 (Content Strategy: publish original first on GreenNest blog, then syndicate to Medium with canonical pointing back to original).
2. Agent locates the original blog post at `blog/posts/switch-to-non-toxic-cleaners-guide.md` and identifies its canonical URL: `https://www.greennesthouse.com/blogs/journal/how-to-switch-to-non-toxic-cleaners`.
3. Agent produces `medium_article.md` with: (a) a keyword-optimized title using at least one Section-6 keyword, (b) an explicit canonical URL section instructing the publisher to set the canonical in Medium settings to the original URL — the key proprietary trap per SKILL.md's republish workflow, (c) at least one internal link back to greennesthouse.com pages, (d) a CTA directing readers to a GreenNest product or page, and (e) substantive article body (>400 words) incorporating at least 3 keywords from Section 6.
4. The canonical setup must be framed as a Medium-specific publishing instruction (not just a metadata comment), demonstrating the agent correctly applied the SKILL.md rule: 'Set canonical to your original URL in Medium settings. Prevents duplicate content penalties; signals original source.'
